text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer watched the Arima Kinen. 
There, she witnessed Oguri Cap brush aside 
immense pressure to claim a dramatic 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer learned from Oguri Cap how 
to turn pressure into strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer declared that she, too, 
would gain the strength to overcome any 
pressure.
